top: Wladimir Klitschko auctioned his Olympic gold medal for charity. It sold for $1 million. Then the buyer did something nobody expected.
comment: He gave it right back. His wish was for the medal to stay with the Klitschko family, and the $1 million went to their foundation for kids 🥇
topic_it: Wladimir Klitschko mette all'asta la medaglia d'oro di Atlanta 1996 (Kyiv, marzo 2012) per beneficenza: 1 milione di dollari, il compratore gliela restituisce

title: He sold his medal, then this happened #inspiring #boxing #olympics
description:
Wladimir Klitschko auctioned his 1996 Olympic gold medal for children's charity in 2012. It sold for $1 million, and the buyer gave it straight back.
